HatchPattern__CladdingBoards__Meta.Meta__Description: Timber or composite board cladding for elevations - the board joints as evenly spaced parallel lines, 150 mm boards, vertical. Turned a quarter turn it is horizontal weatherboarding.
HatchPattern__CladdingBoards__Meta.Meta__WhyPaperUnits: Every length here is PAPER millimetres, like the dash patterns in Na__LayoutEditor__EdgeStyles__Config__.json, so the hatch measures the same on the sheet at 1:20 and at 1:100. Pattern scale adjusts from there.
HatchPattern__CladdingBoards__Meta.Meta__RealSize: Drawn at 1:50: a 150 mm board is 3 mm on paper. SET PATTERN SCALE TO 50 / THE DRAWING SCALE for true boards: 0.5 at 1:100, 1 at 1:50. For another board width multiply by width / 150.
HatchPattern__CladdingBoards__Meta.Meta__WhySeams: Each joint runs from the top edge to the bottom edge, square on, and none comes within 1.5 mm of a side edge.

HatchPattern__CladdingBoards__Identity.Identity__Description: How this pattern is named, found and grouped in the pattern lists.
HatchPattern__CladdingBoards__Identity.Identity__Note: Board cladding in ELEVATION. Vertical as drawn; set Pattern deg to 90 for horizontal boarding.

HatchPattern__CladdingBoards__Tile.Tile__Description: The repeating cell, in paper millimetres.
HatchPattern__CladdingBoards__Tile.Tile__Note: Four boards wide. Square, so it turns a quarter turn without changing.

HatchPattern__CladdingBoards__Defaults.Defaults__Description: What the pattern draws with until a use sets its own. The stroke is 0.25 pt (0.0882 mm) at scale 1 and grows with the pattern scale; a line weight typed in the panel does not. 'inherit' takes the colour of whatever carries the hatch - a vector's edge colour - until a pattern colour is picked.

HatchPattern__CladdingBoards__Glyphs.Glyphs__Description: Drawn about the glyph's own origin, y pointing DOWN, in tile millimetres. Strokes only: the PDF stamps a tile as lines and never fills one.

HatchPattern__CladdingBoards__Placements.Place__Note: The whole tile is one glyph at the origin

HatchPattern__CladdingBoards__Bounds.Bounds__Description: Scale 1 is real size at 1:50. 0.10 is 1:500 and 10 is 1:5.
